rationale: One focused rescue reviewed the exact TrumpFile page, its cited Vox explainer, and the Times URL already present in the prior held204 terminal. The Times page exposed metadata about alleged secret Kiev payments but no extractable article text or Crimea/protest text in the fetched HTML, so the prior held204 account of a 2006 protest allegation was not independently verified here. That prior result is marked coordinator_release_status “unreviewed”; its release_ready flag is not approval.
